Image Credit: Lyndsey O'Brien from Wasteland Architects Updated Guide can be found here What is Verdant Season? Verdant Season is a region-based "event." When you are farming plants, such as Silt Beans, Ash Rose, or Pitcher Plants, in a region where Verdant Season is active, there is a 1 out of 3 (33%) chance that you will receive double the number of plants.
